summary: JM Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a NYSE American delisting notice dated June 12, 2026. The Exchange initiated proceedings under Sections 1001, 1002(e), and 1003 of the NYSE American Company Guide, citing unsuitability for continued trading following a prior SEC trading suspension (January 15, 2026) and ongoing investigations into third-party social media communications. The company disagrees with the decision and has until June 19, 2026 to request a review by the Listings Qualifications Panel. Management is evaluating options. No price, premium, or deal terms apply. The key risk is whether JM Group can successfully appeal or must pursue alternative listing.
